pregame.pressurePoint: Chargers ground game vs Seahawks run front. The Seahawks are No. 1 of 32 against the run by EPA (-0.35). The Chargers rank No. 28 in rush EPA per carry (-0.22). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. The Seahawks win first contact. Backs get met in the backfield; screens and the quick game are the counter. Watch tackles for loss. The Seahawks living in the backfield early is the tell.
